text:
Type: white and oak three-drawer chest
Use: storing clothes and linens, top for a lamp and decor; bedroom, living room, hallway
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, modern
Materials: oak-effect laminated frame in a white-stained finish, white matte drawer fronts
Colors: white, pale greyish oak
Shape: low boxy cabinet with a wood-tone frame wrapping three flush white drawers, small curved notch grips cut into the top edges, plinth base, clean lines, compact
Feel: light, fresh, calm, simple
Goes with: white walls, light wood floors, pale grey textiles; Scandinavian or minimalist bedrooms

product.name: ASKVOLL
product.description: Of course your home should be a safe place for the entire family. Thats why a safety fitting is included so that you can attach the chest of drawers to the wall.
